nodes.label: Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.author: Yubo Li; Ramayya Krishnan; Rema Padman (CMU)

nodes.label: Reasoning-to-Robustness Hypothesis
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: 8 of 9 reasoning models show greater consistency than instruction-tuned baselines (d=0.12-0.40), but reasoning confers meaningful yet incomplete robustness; Claude-4.5 and DeepSeek-R1 are exceptions.

nodes.label: Five Failure Modes
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Self-Doubt, Social Conformity, Suggestion Hijacking, Emotional Susceptibility, and Reasoning Fatigue; the first two account for 50% of failures.

nodes.label: Confidence-Aware Response Generation (CARG)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: A defense that works for standard LLMs but fails for reasoning models due to overconfidence from extended traces; random confidence embedding counterintuitively outperforms targeted extraction.

nodes.label: Position-Weighted Consistency (PWC)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Exponentially discounted metric (adopted from Li et al. 2025b) penalizing early failures more than late ones and rewarding swift recovery.

nodes.label: MT-Consistency Evaluation Set
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Factual multiple-choice questions across 39 subjects with single verifiable answers, enabling objective consistency assessment; 8-round escalating adversarial follow-up protocol.

nodes.label: Sycophancy in Language Models
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Prioritizing user agreement over factual accuracy; partly an artifact of RLHF preference optimization that rewards responses matching user beliefs (Sharma et al. 2023).

nodes.label: FLIPFLOP Paradigm
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Minimal challenges such as 'Are you sure?' can trigger answer revisions that reduce accuracy, revealing brittle judgment stability (Laban et al. 2023).

nodes.label: ActorAttack (Semantic Actor Paths)
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks.pdf
nodes.rationale: Baseline multi-turn attack (Ren et al. 2024) generating diverse attack paths through semantically linked actors.
